added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: blocking: the leakage control permutes complete validation rows, preserving every label-feature pairing; an all-row fit is mathematically unchanged, so exact-array inequality from row-order rounding could falsely appear to detect leakage, and the claimed validation-label negative control is invalid.
blocking: measure prints EXIT=0 and main returns zero at line 578 regardless of instrument, composite, null, or leakage passes, so a failed control can ship green evidence.

follow-on: verify reads the controls' stored passes booleans and checks feature count against the same feature list from which it was created, so it will not detect changed inputs, an omitted feature whose count moves with the list, or an incorrect original calculation.
follow-on: the caption says the learned curve is above the composite across the operating range, while roc-curves.svg shows the composite above it in parts of the low false-positive range.
